activity_summary: Your father was cutting fine gloves by eye. He said Gilbert had been counting, and he named the other baker at thirty shillings, the shoemaker under two pounds, and the skins at a few shillings. You did not correct him, and you did not put the ticket on the bench. He showed a yellowed scrap once, the pattern from his year as bailiff, and said they would have made him a gentleman once, and then wool fell. You said a player is a gentleman three hours every afternoon. Your mother remembered the colour of the ink and would not name it. The scrap went back. Nothing was filed, asked, or promised.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the ticket in his sleeve, answered with three hours, and promised nothing.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the debts cheerfully and low, showed the scrap once, and put it away.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Remembered the colour without naming it, and took the wish off the supper table.

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: Gilbert's been counting. He was always a counting child.

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: They'd have made me a gentleman once, Will. Then wool fell.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A player is a gentleman three hours every afternoon.

quotes.speaker: john_shakespeare
quotes.text: A player! Well. I've seen aldermen do it for nothing and worse.
